items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Slim Jones, he had confidence in him [Kelly Martin]... it was Slim Jones's Place

ctx.x: When you mentioned that Kelly Martin ran a tight ship, were there rules that you all had to observe?

Oh yeah. You had to be on time and you be neat and clean and play, you know, Play the right notes, you know what I mean, and be a professional. No foolin' around, you know what I mean. And that's the way it was. And that's the way he was able to keep that job, because Slim Jones, he had confidence in him and, you know, it was a steady job, it was the best job in Detroit.
What was that paying for you? What was the range?
